content: Yes, you can start tomato seeds in bunches. However, it's important to note that they will need to be separated and transplanted to provide them with enough space to grow properly. Tomato seedlings can become stunted and have difficulty growing if they become too crowded. Typically, you would plant several seeds in each pot or cell, and then thin them to the strongest one or two plants after they sprout.
